name: Northern red oak, Green-Wood Celebrated Tree Walk
reason: The map's stop text is about a red oak infected with oak wilt in 2016, the first NYC case; OSM node is generically named, so which trunk it is and whether it still stands is unknown. Possibly dead or removed.

name: European horse chestnut, Green-Wood stop 1
reason: Only a species blurb on the owner's map and an OSM species node; no size, age or story that makes this trunk worth the visit.

name: Yoshino cherry group of 5, Green-Wood
reason: Young ornamental planting, five trees, not ancient and not a single collectible point.

name: Green-Wood tulip tree, the largest tree in the cemetery (110 ft, nearly 6 ft trunk diameter)
reason: Genuinely worth a visit (owner's 2023/2025 map, stop 'Tulip Tree'), but no pin: not in OSM, Tree Finder (gardens.green-wood.com ArcGIS experience) unreachable by curl (hangs) and refused in the browser pane. Lead for a session with working access.

name: Green-Wood common hackberry, NY State Champion
reason: Owner's map names it a state champion but gives no location; no pin in reach.

name: Green-Wood American elm, 'one of the largest still existent'; cedar of Lebanon; shagbark hickory; common persimmon; sourwood; littleleaf linden
reason: Celebrated Tree Walk stops with species blurbs only, no pin or size in any reachable source.

name: Moravian Cemetery, Staten Island: any named tree
reason: No source names an individual old tree; searches found only generic mentions and an iNaturalist species list. Nothing to verify.
